text:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — planning a staggered integration of FlashAttention v3 for paged attention + a couple KV-cache behavior tweaks. Want quick sync on batching heuristics, fallback thresholds, and perf regression guardrails.

Alex Rivera: +1. I ran microbenchmarks on a patched runtime yesterday. For base gpt-like model: v3 wins for seq<=1024, but for paged KV there are spike cases at seq ~ 16k where p99 increases. I have traces.

Alex Rivera: profiling summary:
- step latency (tokens/sec) improved ~18% median for 512/1024 seqs
- p99 increased ~12% at long sequences when KV page misses happen
- CPU overhead for kernel selection up ~3%

Priya Singh: Can you drop the flamegraph link? we should check if the p99 is KV-eviction related or a kernel fallback path.

Alex Rivera: https://internal.perf/trace/2045-flame-paged-kv (small chart)

Dan Kim: Quick note on heuristics: current batcher decides kernel by (seq, batch_size, kv_hit_rate_est). For v3 we should gate fused-attn for batch_size<4 and seq<256 — fused seems slower for tiny batches in our tests.

Maria Chen: Good. Also we need rollout feature flags with staggered thresholds and automatic fallback if p50/p95 degrade beyond thresholds for 15m. Proposed flags:

```
FF_FLASH_V3_ENABLE=true
FF_FLASH_V3_CANARY_PERCENT=3
FF_FLASH_V3_PAGED=true
FF_FLASH_V3_FUSED_THRESHOLD_BATCH=4
FF_FLASH_V3_KV_EVICT_MS=90000
FF_FLASH_V3_AUTO_FALLBACK_P95=1.12  # fallback if p95 > baseline*1.12 for 15m
```

Priya Singh: Suggest separate flag for kernel-choice override so we can force v2 for specific models/routes: FF_FLASH_KERNEL_OVERRIDE=\"model:rev_id=kernel\". That way SRE can patch without deploy.

Dan Kim: For canary scheduling: stagger by region and GPU class. Start with 3% in us-west on a small pool of A10Gs, then expand to 10% and add p4s. Monitor the KV hit/miss ratio and cache eviction rates.

Maria Chen: Ops checks for the canary: token-success-rate, p50/p95/p99, error-rates, kv-evictions/sec, memory spike > 90%. If any alarm triggers, roll back automatically.

infra-bot: deploy scheduled: flash-v3-canary -> 2045679000; will notify on completion.

Alex Rivera: One more profiling detail: fused attention v3 uses a different scratch allocator that can cause +20MB GPU mem churn under mixed sequence lengths — that's the main reason for the p99 spikes. We can mitigate by tightening KV page prefetch and increasing per-worker KV window.

Priya Singh: Action items:
- Alex: upload full traces and a short runbook for regression triage (ETA EOD)
- Dan: update canary plan to include region/GPU breakdown and rollback hooks (ETA tomorrow morning)
- Maria: add flags to feature flag service + implement auto-fallback thresholds in runtime (ETA 48h)

Dan Kim: Will also add a temporary metric: flash_v3_kernel_switch_count to spot oscillation between kernels.

Maria Chen: If all agree, start with small canary and keep v2 as fallback for model families with high long-seq traffic.

Alex Rivera: :thumbsup: I'll prepare a short PR with the new kernel selector heuristics and a smoke test that exercises long-paged sequences.

Priya Singh: I'll coordinate on dashboards/alerts, will add a checklist to the runbook.

sre_oncall: FYI — I'll be watching the canary window. Ping me if we need emergency rollback.

Maria Chen: Thanks everyone. We'll reconvene after the first canary wave and decide expansion cadence.
